from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,requests,pdfplumber
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
d=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1')
assert not (d/'source_receipt.json').exists(),'E5来源已取得，不重复'
url='https://home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/auction_survey_202311.pdf'
r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 HistoricalResearch/1.0'})
assert r.status_code==200
p=d/'auction_survey_202311.pdf'
p.write_bytes(r.content)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
receipt={'url':url,'source_path':str(p).replace('\\','/'),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),'retrieved_at':stamp,'http_status':r.status_code,'requests':1}
(d/'source_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
    pages=[page.extract_text(layout=True) or '' for page in pdf.pages]
    dimensions=[{'width':page.width,'height':page.height} for page in pdf.pages]
assert len(pages)==1
(d/'auction_survey_202311.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(pages),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
exe=Path(r'E:\CodexData\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\poppler\Library\bin\pdftoppm.EXE')
prefix=d/'调查原件'
command=[str(exe),'-png','-r','160','-singlefile',str(p.resolve()),str(prefix.resolve())]
render=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
assert render.returncode==0 and prefix.with_suffix('.png').is_file()
(d/'原调查渲染回执.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':command,'return_code':render.returncode,'pages':1,'dimensions':dimensions,'visually_checked':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'调查PDF页':1,'原页尺寸':dimensions,'金额时段需核对':'FY24/25/26年末，不能自动当下一季度预期','新拟合':0,'新账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
